question:
Simplify the given expression.

9 times 0.9 times 0.09 times 0.009 times (1)/(0.3) times (1)/(0.03)times (1)/(0.003)
solution:
**Given:**

9 times 0.9 times 0.09 times 0.009 times (1)/(0.3) times (1)/(0.03)times (1)/(0.003)

**Concept used:**

Division

**Calculation:**

9 times 0.9 times 0.09 times 0.009 times (1)/(0.3) times (1)/(0.03)times (1)/(0.003) = 9×3×3×3=243

**∴ The value of the given expression is 243.**
